scope: Independent read-only review of three current green Pelican workflow heads after normal source scan. Only this receipt is written. No code/UI, DB/settings changes, tests, scans, live source requests, model calls or terminal accesses.

conclusion.confirmed_fact: All three green results use the explicitly sourced virtual USD10000 workflow capital fallback. Their H1 reconstruction passes the implemented H1/reference-price/closed-export-position checks; annual return and Calmar use that same virtual basis. None proves actual real-account Equity-DD.
conclusion.gate_contract_review: No confirmed newly introduced green-gate violation found. Repository records attribute the source virtual fallback to the user on 2026-09-28, document Pelican green candidates after H1 rescan on 2026-10-04, and retain this model with explicit comparison limits on 2026-10-16. Current rules require reliable own H1 measurement, without a separately explicit ban on virtual workflow capital. Historical user decisions are supported by repository records/tests, not independently available raw conversation transcripts.
conclusion.no_new_rule: A universal real-capital requirement would be a new or clarified valuation policy. No new gate, threshold or FORENSICS_VERSION change is introduced.
conclusion.separate_overlay: true_dd_basis_virtuell marks a separately applied virtual study, not global capital provenance. False here does not assert real workflow capital. Workflow origin is kapitalbasis_verwendet_quelle / persisted kapitalbasis.quelle. Virtual study fields do not populate workflow Calmar/DD gates.
conclusion.labelling: All three hydrated verdicts and candidate prompts contain the virtual-capital notice. Forensic prompt JSON carries usd10000 and quelle virtuelle_annahme. Existing tests ensure report hashes distinguish a virtual from a proven basis even when the amount is identical.
presentation_limits: Generic True-DD/TrueRetDD terminology and retdd_basis gemessener_max_equity_drawdown_inkl_floating do not alone mean actual real-account measurement; capital provenance must accompany these values.
verlaesslich=True refers to implemented reconstruction/coverage checks, not proof of actual deposit history, current open positions, execution spread, intrabar minima or the full live account.
The separate study-overlay boolean cannot serve as a global real/virtual flag.

No internal H1 floating measurement point exists for HRC103/109, GOLD Tokyo297/521 and BULL10/367 trades. This is a concrete H1 sampling limitation already covered by the verdict warning about missing intrabar lows and closed-export positions.
